style: A single centered object for a medieval strategy game trait icon, in a dark painterly digital illustration style with rich muted colours, soft dramatic lighting and visible brushwork, like an illuminated manuscript rendered as an oil painting. No text, no letters, no border, no frame, no background scenery.

icons.kehillah_rabbi_trait: A bearded scholar in a dark kaftan and kippah, seen in profile from the side, hunched over a large open book on a lectern with a single candle beside it. Face in shadow, pages turned away from the viewer, no legible writing.
icons.kohen: A pair of hands raised in the priestly blessing, fingers parted in the traditional shape, wrapped in a white prayer shawl with blue stripes.
icons.levite: A silver ewer and basin used for ritual hand washing, with a small harp beside them.
icons.kehillah_apostate_trait: A tattered white prayer shawl with blue stripes lying crumpled and half torn, with a broken wax seal.
